title: [November 5, 2026] Proposed Changes to Spark for Upcoming Spell
body: [November 5, 2026] Proposed Changes to Spark for Upcoming Spell Introduction Goal of this update This update proposes six changes across Base and Ethereum for the Spark Spell and one change in the Sky Core Spell: [Base] Spark Liquidity Layer - Activate the Diamond PAU parallel controller on the existing Base ALM Proxy, open a CCTP V2 USDC route from Base to Ethereum, and update who can add and remove the controller’s operators. [Base] Spark Liquidity Layer - Grant the PAS Configurator admin over the Base PAU Access Controls and PAU Rate Limits. [Base] Spark Liquidity Layer - Transfer admin of the Base Diamond PAU Beacon from the Base Spark Executor to the Sky governance relay. [Ethereum] Spark Liquidity Layer - Onboard mint and redeem of OUSD through two Bridge deposit addresses held for the Spark Assets Foundation. [Ethereum] Spark Liquidity Layer - Onboard the Uniswap v4 OUSD/USDS pool for swaps and liquidity provision. [Ethereum] SparkLend - Claim accrued SparkLend reserves and route them to the Spark Liquidity Layer and the Spark Operations Multisig (recurring). [Sky Core] Raise the auto-line ttl of ALLOCATOR-SPARK-A from 12 hours to 24 hours. Items 1, 2 and 3 are separate actions on the same Base Diamond PAU stack, proposed as one package. The transfer of first-loss capital to the Spark Operations Multisig, filed in the pre-submission for this spell, moves to the November 19, 2026 spell. Required context Governance route and execution Items 1, 2 and 3 go to one SPK Snapshot poll as a package, and Items 4 and 5 each to their own poll, on the sparkfi.eth space , then to the Sky executive vote. Item 6 is the recurring reserve claim, authorized by Atlas A.6.1.1.1.2.6.1.2.1.2.3 - Token Claim Authorization once the Operational Executor Agent has approved it (Pre-requirement 10), and goes to the executive vote without an SPK poll. Item 7 is a Sky Core action, requested from Sky Core through this proposal and carried out in the Sky Core spell (Pre-requirement 7). Spell implementation. The payloads and their tests are developed in spark-spells#209 , the source repository for the payload implementation and tests, under src/proposals/20261105/ . The deployed payload addresses will be listed under Pre-requirement 8. Two payloads. The Ethereum payload executes as the Spark SubProxy eth:0x3300f198988e4C9C63F75dF86De36421f06af8c4 and carries Items 4 to 6. It relays PAYLOAD_BASE , carrying Items 1, 2 and 3, through the hook already in SparkPayloadEthereum.execute() : OptimismForwarder to the Base Spark Receiver, which queues it on the Base Spark Executor. This is the path every prior Base payload has used. The Base Spark Executor applies no delay of its own; the timelock is the Sky GSM pause on Ethereum. Office hours. SparkPayloadEthereum.officeHours() restricts execution to Monday to Friday, 14:00 to 21:00 UTC. On-chain reads. Unless a different block is stated, every value was read with the call pinned to Ethereum block 26,250,372 (block timestamp 2026-10-22 19:52:47 UTC) and Base block 52,954,712 (19:52:51 UTC). Explorer prefixes: eth: is etherscan.io , base: is basescan.org . The Base Diamond PAU stack (Items 1, 2 and 3) Precedent. These items repeat, on Base, the Arbitrum items of the October 8, 2026 spell , which executed on Arbitrum on 2026-10-12. The Base contracts were deployed from the same commits on 2026-09-21 and reviewed with the Arbitrum ones on spark-address-registry#115 . The Base payload makes the same Diamond PAU, PAS and Beacon calls, in the same order, as the executed Arbitrum payload. New controller scope. A Diamond PAU Controller with one integration, the CCTP V2 facet, sits beside the existing ForeignController . After Item 1 both controllers hold CONTROLLER on the same Base ALM Proxy. The new controller’s only fund-moving action is a CCTP V2 burn of USDC from the Base ALM Proxy, minted to the Ethereum ALM Proxy, within the rate limits Item 1 sets. The CCTP V1 route on the legacy controller is unchanged, so total outbound CCTP capacity from Base is the sum of the two. Governance of the stack. Today the Base Spark Executor is the sole admin of the Beacon, the PAU Access Controls and the PAU Rate Limits. After Item 2 the PAS Configurator also holds admin over the PAU Access Controls and the PAU Rate Limits, operated by the registered cBEAM within bounds set by Sky Governance; what that admin allows is set out in Proposed actions 2. After Item 3 the Sky governance relay replaces the Base Spark Executor as admin of the Beacon, so registering a new integration for this stack becomes a Sky Governance action. Item 1 also moves the Administered Agent’s grantor seat to a Soter Labs multisig, adds a Soter Labs freezer multisig as a second revoker, and adds the Spark hot wallet as a second actor, as on Arbitrum. Items 4 and 5 - OUSD Issuer. OUSD is issued by Open Standard on Bridge’s stablecoin platform and is live on Ethereum at eth:0x9f6F3991D525015a6F8CaF062C83b62fD3AC4436 : name “OpenUSD”, symbol OUSD , 6 decimals, total supply on Ethereum 134,295,299.58. Open Standard is an independent company governed by a board drawn from OUSD’s partners ( Introducing Open USD ). Token admin. The token contract is upgradeable by a single key. It is a UUPS proxy over an implementation verified on Etherscan as StablecoinTemplateV3 , eth:0x264048239Dd1b5939599fAE8e6000DF40248D524 , and its owner() and sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder is the EOA eth:0x79C6631FA15CdA38777FB9DD7a6348bAEe794a4E . Precedent. The mechanisms are not new. Item 4 repeats the transferAsset rate-limit pattern the February 26, 2026 spell used to onboard Paxos for PYUSD and USDG. Item 5 repeats the Uniswap v4 configuration the August 13, 2026 spell used for RLUSD/USDS and USDG/USDS. What is new is the issuer and the asset. The reason(s) behind this update Diamond PAU controller with CCTP V2 (Item 1). Spark activates the Diamond PAU on Base with the CCTP V2 facet as its first integration. Circle is phasing out CCTP V1: burn limits are reduced from 2026-10-31 and the V1 contracts are paused on 2026-12-01 ( Circle ). Spark’s Base route runs on V1, and Spark plans to migrate it to V2 through this controller. Further integrations can be added to the Diamond PAU later. PAS Configurator (Item 2). Brings the Parallelized Allocation System into service on the Base Diamond PAU, so rate limits and pre-approved controller actions, including disabling the facet during an incident, can be managed through the PAS Configurator without a spell each time. Beacon admin (Item 3). The Beacon is the registry of which facet belongs to each integration. It should be under Sky Governance, so its admin is transferred from Spark to Sky, as was done for the Arbitrum Beacon on 2026-10-12. OUSD mint and redeem (Item 4). Holding an issuer’s stablecoin through primary mint and redeem, rather than only on a secondary market, lets the Spark Liquidity Layer size a position without paying a market spread in either direction. Uniswap v4 OUSD/USDS pool (Item 5). Lets the Spark Liquidity Layer provide OUSD/USDS liquidity near par and swap between OUSD and USDS on-chain. Claim SparkLend reserves (Item 6). Consolidates accrued reserves: stablecoin reserves reach the ALM Proxy, where they earn, and the rest go to the Spark Operations Multisig to be liquidated. Auto-line ttl (Item 7). A 24 hour ttl lets Spark’s debt ceiling step up once a day instead of twice, by up to the unchanged 1,500,000,000 gap. Timing of this update (in stages, if needed) This update is not staged. All Spark actions are in one governance package, the Ethereum spell, whose Base payload is relayed from it and executes on Base once the Ethereum spell executes. Item 7 is in the Sky Core spell of the same executive cycle. SPK Snapshot polls for Items 1 to 5 - open 2026-10-26, close 2026-10-29. Spell up for the Sky executive vote - 2026-11-05 , executing on or after about 2026-11-09 , subject to office hours, the executive vote passing and the GSM pause delay. The Base Diamond PAU contracts were deployed on 2026-09-21 and the Base PAS contracts on 2026-10-16 (Pre-deployed contracts 1 and 2). The remaining milestones are the payload deployment, its independent review and handover to Sky, tracked as Pre-requirements. Relevant scope of the audit: transferAsset and its LIMIT_ASSET_TRANSFER keys (Item 4), and the UniswapV4Lib position and swap flows with tick limits and maximum slippage (Item 5), introduced in v1.9.0 and reviewed by Cantina and Certora.
